artifact_delivered: Walk-forward backtest with transaction costs — revealed Q-learning overfits in-sample
workstream_summary: C535: Built bin/rl_trading_backtest.py — walk-forward CV with transaction costs. Found: (1) RL trades 251x with 43.7 pp cost drag on TSLA, (2) only beats buy-and-hold in 1/3 out-of-sample windows, (3) simple MA crossover (10/30) returned 174.3% — strongest signal. Key insight: tabular Q-learning overtrades due to discretized state confidence. Next: DQN with continuous features + trade penalty, or regime-aware agent.
